title: Meta’s Muse: How we launched the most successful consumer product this year | Mona Sarantakos
author: Lenny Rachitsky
description: Listen now | Mona Sarantakos on going from a weekend with OpenClaw to shipping the fastest-growing consumer AI product in history
summary: Muse is the #1 app in the App Store and arguably the fastest-growing AI consumer product of all time. Mona Sarantakos has led product on it since day one.
takeaways: Mona Sarantakos has led product on it since day one.
She’s VP of Product at Meta Superintelligence Labs and a 10-year Meta veteran with over 20 years of experience as a PM.
